author: Arnav
problem: Read an odd number N and N votes, each 'For' or 'Against'. Print Yes if more than half of the votes are 'For', otherwise No.
bug_description: Uses >= n // 2 instead of > n // 2, so (N-1)/2 For votes, which is less than half, already passes.

comments.accurate: Counts the For votes and checks they're a majority of the N votes
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts the For votes and passes once they reach half of N, rounded down
comments.wrong_location: Majority threshold verified; check each vote is compared without trailing whitespace
